title: New Server Onboarding Guide
subtitle: How to register, connect, collect and assess a new target server.

chk.connect: Connect by OS (Linux SSH / Windows agent run)

quick.s1: Add one server row to servers.csv (name, IP, OS, account, password, port)
quick.s2: Linux uses SSH (port 22). For Windows, run Enable-PSRemoting -Force on the target, then WinRM (port 5985) — this is what you do when registering a new Windows server.
quick.s3: Run a health check on the Servers page to confirm connectivity ✅
quick.s4: Run from Collection; AI/LLM judges, then check AI result & reports
quick.dcNote: Only a DC (Domain Controller) is an exception: AD cmdlets fail over WinRM remoting (double-hop), so run ad_collect.ps1 directly on the DC → upload the JSON result to Result Report. See details below.
